title: Railway RRB Paramedical Staff CEN 03/2025 CBT-I Result/ Cutoff 2026 - Out for 434 Post
intro: Railway Recruitment Board (RRB)  has Officially Released CBT-I Result for the Post of Nursing Superintendent, Dialysis Technician, Health and Malaria Inspector Gr. II, Pharmacist (Entry grade), Radiographer X-ray Technician, ECG Technician, and LAB Assistant Gr. II in Paramedical Category (CEN. No. 03/2025) Recruitment 2025 for 434 Post. Exam Held On March 11-12-13, 2026 & CBT-I Result Available On May 29, 2026. All Interested Candidate Can Download Exan Result Now in The Given Link Below
importantDates: General / OBC/ EWS : Rs.500/-

All Female Candidates : Rs. 250/-

Pay Scale: Initial Pay Rs.29200 (Pay Level as per 7th CPC:7)

10+2 with Physics and Chemistry and Diploma in Radiography/ X Ray Technician / Radiodiagnosis Technology (2 years course) from recognized Insitute. Science graduates with Diploma in Radiography / X Ray Technician / Radiodiagnosis Technology (2 years course) shall be preferred.
Pay Scale: Initial Pay Rs.29200 (Pay Level as per 7th CPC:7)

Pay Scale: Initial Pay Rs.25500 (Pay Level as per 7th CPC:7)
Pay Scale: Initial Pay Rs.21700 (Pay Level as per 7th CPC:7)
The Question paper for Single Stage CBT will be of 90 minutes duration for 100 questions and 120 minutes for PwBD candidates who are availing the Scribe facility.
There  will  be  negative  marking and 1/3 mark shall be deducted for each wrong answer

The  question  papers  shall  be  of  objective  multiple  choice  type  with  four  options.  Only  one  of  these four options will be the correct answer. Language of Question Paper is English & Hindi.
Important Instruction for the All Candidates Expect the Fee Concession Categories.
Candidates Must be Enter the Your Account Number, Account Holder Name, IFSC Code Under Login Section.
Railway Will be Refunded General/ OBC/ EWS Candidates Rs. 400 & SC / ST Candidates Rs. 250/-
After the Appear the First Stage CBT Examination Your Exceed Amount Will be Refunded at Your Bank.
Note : If you have Not Appeared in CBT Exam Amount Not be Refunded.
Pay Scale:      As Per Rule
Mode of Selection:  Selection on the Basis of CBT Exam, Document Verification & Merit List.
